section.45: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

45.name_native: The Book of Oaths (qasamah), Retaliation and Blood Money

hadiths.text: It was narrated from 'Aishah that the Messenger of Allah said:"And it is upon those (relatives) of the killed one to block (any punishment) the first (in line) then the first, even if that one is a woman
